name: JST-XH 2-pin header
summary: The small white 2-pin socket used for batteries and sensors, soldered onto a circuit board. Needs a 10 x 8 mm slot if the plug has to come through a wall.
source: The 2.5 mm pin pitch and the shape of the XH plug are fixed by JST's own drawings. Everything else here is approximate: the body sizes are typical of a 2-pin XH header and vary between the genuine JST part and the many clones sold under the same name. Modelled facing sideways, as the right-angle version does; the more common vertical header has the same board footprint but the plug goes in from above, so turn it accordingly. The 10 x 8 mm panel slot is a suggested opening for passing the plug through a wall, not a manufacturer figure. This part solders to a board, so it has no fixing holes of its own.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and its two wires

electrical.note: Rated about 3 A per pin. Almost always used for low-voltage things: small batteries, fans and sensor leads.
